chalisa.do1: Victory, victory to you, Mother, who dwell between Sītā and Rāma.
Jagadambā, give me your darśana now; Mother, make no delay.
chalisa.do2: Victory to Tārā, victory to Kālikā, victory to the host of the ten Mahāvidyās.
Siddhi, a poet of Hind, composes this Kālī Chālīsā.
chalisa.do3: Whoever reads it on rising at dawn, at noon or in the evening,
his sorrow and poverty are removed and all his works succeed.
chalisa.cau1: Victory to Kālī, who wears a garland of skeletons; victory to Maṅgalā, the great Kapālinī, bearer of skulls.
chalisa.cau2: Mother, slayer of Raktabīja, you are ever the giver of joy to your devotees.
chalisa.cau3: Your limbs are adorned with a garland of heads; victory to Kālī, victory to you, intoxicated with wine.
chalisa.cau4: You dwell in delight in the lotus of Śiva's heart; victory to Jagadambā, destroyer of all sorrow.
chalisa.cau5: Hrīṃ, Kālī; śrīṃ, Mahākarālī, the most terrible; krīṃ, Kalyāṇī the benign, Dakṣiṇākālī.
chalisa.cau6: Victory to Kalāvatī, mistress of the arts, victory to Vidyāvatī, mistress of knowledge; victory to Tārā, Sundarī, of great wisdom.
chalisa.cau7: Give me good understanding, take away every hardship; appear before your devotee.
chalisa.cau8: Victory to you who are Om, victory to you who are the syllable hum; victory to the great Śakti, the boundless one.
chalisa.cau9: You are Kamalā, destroyer of the pride of the Kali age, and ever the destroyer of your devotees' fear.
chalisa.cau10: Jagadambā, delay no longer; take away my sorrow and poverty.
chalisa.cau11: Victory to Kālikā, the terrible Mother, whose body blazes like the fire of dissolution.
chalisa.cau12: Victory to Śaṅkarī, queen of the gods, the eternal; you are the ancient Mother of countless siddhis and of the poet Siddhi.
chalisa.cau13: Kapardinī, deliverer from the Kali age and the kalpa; victory to you whose eyes are like a lotus newly blossomed.
chalisa.cau14: Bringer of joy, treasury of joy, Mother, give me pure knowledge.
chalisa.cau15: You are an ocean of the nectar of compassion, full of grace; now be merciless to the wicked.
chalisa.cau16: All living beings are supremely dear to you; the whole universe rests on you.
chalisa.cau17: You dance at the time of dissolution; victory to the Mother who sustains the whole world.
chalisa.cau18: You are Mahodarī, Maheśvarī and Māyā, daughter of the Himālaya, the shade of the universe.
chalisa.cau19: Baring your teeth at will, amid a death-dealing din, you alone roar, and no other.
chalisa.cau20: You sparkle across the expanse like clusters of gems; you are the hosts of stars in the canopy of the sky.
chalisa.cau21: You bear splendour and do good to the saints; fire in hand, you tear apart the most wicked.
chalisa.cau22: You are the taker of Dhūmralocana's life, the crusher of Śumbha and Niśumbha, the fair-eyed one.
chalisa.cau23: Thousand-armed, you wear a garland of lotuses; Cāmuṇḍā, you dwell in the cremation ground.
chalisa.cau24: With the skull-bowl filled with blood, Mother, you killed the vile Mahiṣāsura.
chalisa.cau25: Ambā, Ambikā, Caṇḍā, Caṇḍikā: all are one, and that one is you, the primal Kālikā.
chalisa.cau26: You are unborn, of one form and of many forms; your doings are beyond telling, and your power is beyond compare.
chalisa.cau27: At the southern gate of Calcutta stands your image, boundless Maheśī.
chalisa.cau28: You are Śyāmā, the dark one, rapt in drinking kādambarī wine; victory to Mātaṅgī, the abode of desire.
chalisa.cau29: You dwell on a lotus seat, your home is the lotus; victory to Śyāmā, victory, victory to the dark Goddess.
chalisa.cau30: Victory to Mātaṅgī, victory to you, Prakṛti; victory to you, the devotion in the heart, ill sense and good sense.
chalisa.cau31: You grant the wishes of countless Brahmās, Śivas and Viṣṇus; victory to you who give birth to non-violence and dharma.
chalisa.cau32: You pervade water, land and the vault of the sky; amid the lightning you raise your song.
chalisa.cau33: You sound forth jhananana, tacchu, maririna; victory to Sarasvatī, player of the vīṇā.
chalisa.cau34: Om aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ cāmuṇḍāyai vicce (the mantra of Cāmuṇḍā). Human heads adorn your graceful throat.
chalisa.cau35: Victory to the Mother of the universe and of the poet Siddhi; you are Kāmākhyā and Mother Kālī.
chalisa.cau36: You dwell at Hiṅglāj and on the Vindhya hills; your laughter thunders, and you destroy sins.
chalisa.cau37: Undivided one, how much can I praise you? You are the universe, Caṇḍī, who conquer by your power.
chalisa.cau38: Jagadambā, be gracious to all; with you as their support, they live free of fear.
chalisa.cau39: You are Kālī, four-armed and dark; your form is most delightful.
chalisa.cau40: The sword and the skull-bowl shine in your hands; you charm the minds of gods, men and sages, all of them.
chalisa.cau41: Whoever gains your grace knows neither disease nor sorrow.
chalisa.cau42: Whoever recites this Chālīsā has the grace of Śiva, lord of Gaurī.
chalisa.do4: Victory to Kapālinī, victory to Śivā, victory, victory, victory to Jagadambā.
Mother, giver of support, ever take away the sorrows of your devotees.
